english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone or something makes you angry or annoyed.
This is the all-purpose choice when someone or something makes another person angry or annoyed.
Use this when the person is vexed, annoyed, or made angry rather than publicly embarrassed.
Use this specifically when the person is made angry rather than merely unhappy or distressed.
